title: Battle of Başgedikler
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Başgedikler", at revision 1370433693, opens: "The Battle of Başgedikler occurred on 1 December 1853 during the Crimean War when a Russian army attacked and defeated a large Turkish force near the village of Başgedikler in the Trans-Caucasus." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q19631987, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle that took place during the Crimean War in 1853". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
